<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

`pij directory retype` proposes a type for every untyped role from its template and then its id, writes those it is sure of with `--apply` in one governance commit, and lists the rest with the line that types each.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- A community written before PRD 006 is typed with one command.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- Guessing a type it is not sure of: undecided roles are listed, never typed.

<a id="execution-guardrails"></a>

## Execution Guardrails

- Cost: on demand only: one in-process read of the role documents; `--apply` is one writer commit (the launches a governance write makes today). No loop, poll or timer.
- No permission rule changes (PRD 003); no daemon enforcement of a type's rules; no existing JSON field removed or renamed.
- Builds nice-19 through `just shared-build`, one at a time.
